export type AgentGateVariant =
  | "questions"
  | "plan"
  | "plugin"
  | "permission"
  | "eval"
  | "secret"
  | "handoff"
  | "schedule";

export type AgentGateBrand = "figma" | "vercel" | "linear" | "mcp";

export type AgentGateDuration = "once" | "session" | "always";

export type AgentGateCadence = "once" | "hourly" | "daily" | "weekly";

export type AgentGateSecretAccess = "read" | "write";

export type AgentGateHandoffKind = "human" | "specialist";

export interface AgentGateQuestion {
  id: string;
  prompt: string;
  options: string[];
}

export interface AgentGatePlanStep {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  detail?: string;
}

export interface AgentGatePlugin {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  unlock: string;
  scopes: string[];
  brand?: AgentGateBrand;
  logo?: ReactNode;
}

export interface AgentGatePermission {
  plugin: string;
  action: string;
  resource?: string;
  detail?: string;
  scopes: string[];
  brand?: AgentGateBrand;
  logo?: ReactNode;
}

export interface AgentGateCriterion {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  score: number;
}

export interface AgentGateEval {
  criteria: AgentGateCriterion[];
  issues?: string[];
  overall: number;
  threshold?: number;
}

export interface AgentGateSecret {
  access: AgentGateSecretAccess;
  id: string;
  key: string;
  masked: string;
  value?: string;
}

export interface AgentGateHandoffTarget {
  id: string;
  kind: AgentGateHandoffKind;
  label: string;
}

export interface AgentGateHandoff {
  defaultTarget?: string;
  excerpt: string;
  reason: string;
  targets: AgentGateHandoffTarget[];
}

export interface AgentGateSchedule {
  cadence?: AgentGateCadence;
  startAt?: string;
  summary: string;
  title: string;
  until?: string;
}

export interface AgentGatePayload {
  answers?: Record<string, string>;
  plugin?: string;
  scopes?: string[];
  duration?: AgentGateDuration;
  decision?: "iterate" | "accept" | "revert";
  notes?: string;
  keys?: string[];
  target?: string;
  reason?: string;
  cadence?: AgentGateCadence;
  startAt?: string;
  until?: string;
}

interface AgentGateVariantMeta {
  icon: IconSvgElement;
  iconPrimary: string;
  iconSecondary: string;
  title: string;
  approve: string;
  reject: string;
  iconClass: string;
}

export interface AgentGateProps {
  variant?: AgentGateVariant;
  questions?: AgentGateQuestion[];
  plan?: AgentGatePlanStep[];
  planTitle?: string;
  planSummary?: string;
  planPreviewCount?: number;
  plugins?: AgentGatePlugin[];
  permission?: AgentGatePermission;
  permissionDuration?: AgentGateDuration;
  defaultPermissionDuration?: AgentGateDuration;
  onPermissionDurationChange?: (duration: AgentGateDuration) => void;
  evaluation?: AgentGateEval;
  secrets?: AgentGateSecret[];
  handoff?: AgentGateHandoff;
  schedule?: AgentGateSchedule;
  title?: string;
  approveLabel?: string;
  rejectLabel?: string;
  onApprove?: (payload?: AgentGatePayload) => void;
  onReject?: () => void;
  onDownload?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

const durationLabel = (duration: AgentGateDuration) => {
  switch (duration) {
    case "once": {
      return "Once";
    }
    case "session": {
      return "Session";
    }
    case "always": {
      return "Always";
    }
    default: {
      const _exhaustive: never = duration;
      return _exhaustive;
    }
  }
};

const secretAccessSummary = (secrets: AgentGateSecret[]) => {
  const reads = secrets.filter((secret) => secret.access === "read");
  const writes = secrets.filter((secret) => secret.access === "write");
  const parts: string[] = [];
  const [read] = reads;
  const [write] = writes;
  if (reads.length === 1 && read) {
    parts.push(`Read ${read.key}`);
  } else if (reads.length > 1) {
    parts.push(`Read ${reads.length} keys`);
  }
  if (writes.length === 1 && write) {
    parts.push(`Write ${write.key}`);
  } else if (writes.length > 1) {
    parts.push(`Write ${writes.length} files`);
  }
  if (parts.length === 0) {
    return "No keys listed";
  }
  return parts.join(", ");
};

const writeAnswer = (
  answers: Record<string, string>,
  questionId: string,
  value: string
) => {
  if (value) {
    return { ...answers, [questionId]: value };
  }
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(answers).filter(([id]) => id !== questionId)
  );
};

const formatGateScore = (score: number) => {
  const rounded = Math.round(score * 10) / 10;
  return Number.isInteger(rounded) ? String(rounded) : rounded.toFixed(1);
};

const formatGateTime = (iso: string) => {
  const date = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return iso;
  }
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
    day: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric",
    minute: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
  }).format(date);
};

const cadenceRepeatLabel = (cadence: AgentGateCadence) => {
  switch (cadence) {
    case "once": {
      return "Runs once";
    }
    case "hourly": {
      return "Every hour";
    }
    case "daily": {
      return "Every day";
    }
    case "weekly": {
      return "Every week";
    }
    default: {
      const _exhaustive: never = cadence;
      return _exhaustive;
    }
  }
};

const scheduleWindowCopy = (
  cadence: AgentGateCadence,
  schedule: AgentGateSchedule
) => {
  const start = schedule.startAt ? formatGateTime(schedule.startAt) : null;
  const until =
    cadence === "once" || !schedule.until
      ? null
      : formatGateTime(schedule.until);
  const repeat = cadenceRepeatLabel(cadence);
  if (cadence === "once") {
    return start ? `${repeat} on ${start}` : repeat;
  }
  if (start && until) {
    return `${repeat} from ${start} until ${until}`;
  }
  if (start) {
    return `${repeat} from ${start}`;
  }
  if (until) {
    return `${repeat} until ${until}`;
  }
  return repeat;
};

const scheduleLeadingCopy = (
  cadence: AgentGateCadence,
  schedule: AgentGateSchedule
) => {
  const label =
    CADENCE_OPTIONS.find((item) => item.id === cadence)?.label ?? "Schedule";
  if (!schedule.startAt) {
    return label;
  }
  return `${label} · ${formatGateTime(schedule.startAt)}`;
};

const secretAccessLabel = (access: AgentGateSecretAccess) => {
  switch (access) {
    case "read": {
      return "Read";
    }
    case "write": {
      return "Write";
    }
    default: {
      const _exhaustive: never = access;
      return _exhaustive;
    }
  }
};

const handoffKindLabel = (kind: AgentGateHandoffKind) => {
  switch (kind) {

      return "Human";
    }
    case "specialist": {
      return "Agent";
    }
    default: {

      return _exhaustive;
    }
  }
};

type IconSvgNode = IconSvgElement[number];

const withSecondaryTone = (
  icon: IconSvgElement,
  secondaryKeys: readonly string[]
): IconSvgElement =>
  icon.map((element): IconSvgNode => {
    const [tag, attrs] = element;
    const key = String(attrs.key ?? "");
    if (!secondaryKeys.includes(key)) {
      return element;
    }
    const next: IconSvgNode = [tag, { ...attrs, opacity: 1 }];
    return next;
  });

const variantMeta = (variant: AgentGateVariant): AgentGateVariantMeta => {
  switch (variant) {

      return {

        iconClass: "bg-(--agent-gate-handoff-bg)",

        iconSecondary: "var(--agent-gate-schedule-accent)",

        title: "Run in the background?",
      };
    }
    default: {
      const _exhaustive: never = variant;
      return _exhaustive;
    }
  }
};

const OptionKey = ({
  letter,
  selected,
}: {
  letter: string;
  selected: boolean;
}) => (
  <span
    aria-hidden
    className={cn(
      "text-agent-gate-2xs relative z-0 inline-flex size-4.5 flex-none items-center justify-center rounded-[4px] bg-foreground/6 leading-none font-semibold text-muted-foreground tabular-nums transition-colors duration-150 ease-out",
      "before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-z-1 before:rounded-[inherit] before:bg-primary before:opacity-0 before:transition-opacity before:duration-150 before:ease-out before:content-['']",
      selected && "text-primary-foreground before:opacity-100"
    )}
  >
    {letter}
  </span>
);

const DigitColumn = ({
  char,
  dir,
  reduce,
}: {
  char: string;
  dir: "up" | "down";
  reduce: boolean;
}) => (
  <span className="relative inline-block h-[1em] overflow-hidden align-[-0.05em] leading-none">
    <AnimatePresence initial={false} mode="popLayout">
      <motion.span
        animate={{ y: 0 }}
        className="inline-block h-[1em] leading-none"
        exit={{ y: dir === "up" ? "-1em" : "1em" }}
        initial={{ y: dir === "up" ? "1em" : "-1em" }}
        key={char}
        transition={{
          duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.35,
          ease: [0.4, 0, 0.2, 1],
        }}
      >
        {char === " " ? "\u00A0" : char}
      </motion.span>
    </AnimatePresence>
  </span>
);

const RollingDigits = ({ value }: { value: string }) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const prevRef = useRef(value);
  const [dir, setDir] = useState<"up" | "down">("up");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevRef.current === value) {
      return;
    }
    const fromN = Math.trunc(Number(prevRef.current));
    const toN = Math.trunc(Number(value));
    setDir(
      Number.isFinite(fromN) && Number.isFinite(toN) && toN < fromN
        ? "down"
        : "up"
    );
    prevRef.current = value;
  }, [value]);

  const slots = [...value].map((char, position) => ({
    char,
    id: `col-${position}`,
  }));

  return (
    <output className="inline-flex items-baseline">
      {slots.map((slot) => (
        <DigitColumn
          char={slot.char}
          dir={dir}
          key={slot.id}
          reduce={Boolean(reduce)}
        />
      ))}
    </output>
  );
};

const TodoDashedIcon = ({ className }: { className?: string }) => {
  const dots = 12;
  const dash = 0.022;
  const gap = 1 / dots - dash;
  return (
    <svg
      aria-hidden="true"
      className={cn("absolute inset-0 size-4", className)}
      height="16"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width="16"
    >
      <title>Pending</title>
      <circle
        cx="12"
        cy="12"
        fill="none"
        pathLength={1}
        r="9"
        stroke="currentColor"
        strokeDasharray={`${dash} ${gap}`}
        strokeLinecap="round"
        strokeWidth="1.8"
      />
    </svg>
  );
};

const HeadAction = ({
  label,
  onClick,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  children: ReactNode;
}) => (
  <button
    aria-label={label}
    className="transition-agent-gate-press relative z-0 flex size-6 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-md border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-muted-foreground duration-150 ease-out after:absolute after:top-1/2 after:left-1/2 after:size-6.5 after:-translate-x-1/2 after:-translate-y-1/2 after:content-[''] hover:bg-foreground/6 hover:text-card-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none active:scale-[0.96] dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80"
    onClick={(event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      onClick();
    }}
    type="button"
  >
    {children}
  </button>
);

const APPLE_PLATFORM_RE = /Mac|iPhone|iPad|iPod/u;

const noop = () => {
  // useSyncExternalStore never unsubscribes from this snapshot.
};

const emptySubscribe = () => noop;

const getApplePlatformSnapshot = () =>
  APPLE_PLATFORM_RE.test(navigator.userAgent);

const useIsApplePlatform = () =>
  useSyncExternalStore(emptySubscribe, getApplePlatformSnapshot, () => true);

const isApproveHotkey = (event: {
  altKey: boolean;
  ctrlKey: boolean;
  key: string;
  metaKey: boolean;
  shiftKey: boolean;
}) =>
  event.key === "Enter" &&
  (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey) &&
  !event.shiftKey &&
  !event.altKey;

const ActionButton = ({
  slot,
  variant,
  disabled,
  submit,
  onClick,
  shortcut,
  shortcutKeys,
  buttonRef,
  children,
}: {
  slot: string;
  variant: "ghost" | "primary";
  disabled?: boolean;
  submit?: boolean;
  onClick?: () => void;
  shortcut?: ReactNode;
  shortcutKeys?: string;
  buttonRef?: Ref<HTMLButtonElement>;
  children: ReactNode;
}) => (
  <button
    aria-keyshortcuts={shortcutKeys}
    className={cn(
      "disabled:opacity-agent-gate-muted relative z-0 inline-flex h-6 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-full border-0 px-2 text-(length:--text-agent-gate-sm) leading-none font-medium transition-transform duration-150 ease-out after:absolute after:inset-x-0 after:-inset-y-2 after:content-[''] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none active:enabled:scale-[0.96] disabled:cursor-default dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80",
      "before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-z-1 before:rounded-full before:transition-colors before:duration-150 before:ease-out before:content-['']",
      variant === "ghost" &&
        "text-card-foreground before:bg-foreground/6 hover:before:bg-foreground/10",
      variant === "primary" &&
        "hover:enabled:before:bg-agent-gate-primary-hover pr-1.25 text-primary-foreground before:bg-primary"
    )}
    data-slot={slot}
    disabled={disabled}
    onClick={(event) => {
      if (submit) {
        return;
      }
      event.preventDefault();
      onClick?.();
    }}
    ref={buttonRef}
    type={submit ? "submit" : "button"}
  >
    {children}
    {shortcut}
  </button>
);

const PlanTodoItem = ({
  title,
  detail,
}: {
  title: string;
  detail?: string;
}) => (
  <li className="flex items-start gap-2.25 leading-4.5 text-muted-foreground">
    <span className="relative mt-px size-4 flex-none">
      <TodoDashedIcon />
    </span>
    <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5">
      <span className="font-normal text-pretty">{title}</span>
      {detail ? (
        <span className="text-agent-gate-xs text-pretty">{detail}</span>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  </li>
);

const QuestionSlide = ({
  question,
  active,
  answers,
  otherOn,
  draft,
  qAnimate,
  slideRef,
  inputRef,
  onSelectOption,
  onSelectOther,
  onUpdateCustom,
  onCommitCustom,
}: {
  question: AgentGateQuestion;
  active: boolean;
  answers: Record<string, string>;
  otherOn: boolean;
  draft: string;
  qAnimate: boolean;
  slideRef: Ref<HTMLDivElement>;
  inputRef: Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
  onSelectOption: (opt: string) => void;
  onSelectOther: () => void;
  onUpdateCustom: (text: string) => void;
  onCommitCustom: (raw: string) => void;
}) => {
  const otherLetter = String.fromCodePoint(65 + question.options.length);

  return (
    <div
      aria-hidden={active ? undefined : true}
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-none -translate-y-3 flex-col gap-2 opacity-0",
        active && "translate-y-0 opacity-100",
        qAnimate &&
          "transition-agent-gate-fade ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
        qAnimate && (active ? "duration-300" : "duration-150"),
        !active && "pointer-events-none"
      )}
      data-active={active ? "true" : undefined}
      data-slot="agent-gate-question"
      ref={slideRef}
    >
      <div className="text-agent-gate leading-agent-gate-tight pl-0.5 font-medium text-pretty">
        {question.prompt}
      </div>
      <fieldset className="m-0 flex flex-col gap-1.25 border-0 p-0">
        <legend className="sr-only">{question.prompt}</legend>
        {question.options.map((opt, oi) => {
          const selected = answers[question.id] === opt && !otherOn;
          return (
            <label
              className={cn(OPTION_CLASS, "cursor-pointer")}
              data-selected={selected ? "true" : undefined}
              data-slot="agent-gate-option"
              key={opt}
            >
              <input
                checked={selected}
                className="sr-only"
                disabled={!active}
                name={question.id}
                onChange={() => {
                  if (!active) {
                    return;
                  }
                  onSelectOption(opt);
                }}
                tabIndex={active ? 0 : -1}
                type="radio"
                value={opt}
              />
              <OptionKey
                letter={String.fromCodePoint(65 + oi)}
                selected={selected}
              />
              {opt}
            </label>
          );
        })}
        <div
          className={cn(OPTION_CLASS, "cursor-text")}
          data-other="true"
          data-selected={otherOn ? "true" : undefined}
          data-slot="agent-gate-option-other"
        >
          <label className="relative z-1 flex cursor-text items-center">
            <input
              checked={otherOn}
              className="sr-only"
              disabled={!active}
              name={question.id}
              onChange={() => {
                if (!active) {
                  return;
                }
                onSelectOther();
              }}
              tabIndex={active && !otherOn ? 0 : -1}
              type="radio"
              value="__other"
            />
            <OptionKey letter={otherLetter} selected={otherOn} />
          </label>
          <input
            aria-label={`Custom answer for: ${question.prompt}`}
            className="font-inherit leading-inherit relative z-1 m-0 min-w-0 flex-1 border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-inherit outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground"
            onChange={(event) => {
              if (!active) {
                return;
              }
              onUpdateCustom(event.target.value);
            }}
            onClick={(event) => {
              event.stopPropagation();
              if (!active) {
                return;
              }
              onSelectOther();
            }}
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (isApproveHotkey(event)) {
                return;
              }
              event.stopPropagation();
              if (!active) {
                return;
              }
              if (event.key === "Enter") {
                event.preventDefault();
                onCommitCustom(event.currentTarget.value);
              }
            }}
            placeholder="Something else…"
            ref={inputRef}
            tabIndex={active ? 0 : -1}
            type="text"
            value={draft}
          />
        </div>
      </fieldset>
    </div>
  );
};

const QuestionsViewport = ({
  questions,
  safeStep,
  answers,
  qViewportH,
  qTrackY,
  qAnimate,
  questionRefs,
  customInputRefs,
  isOtherChoice,
  customDraft,
  onSelectOption,
  onSelectOther,
  onUpdateCustom,
  onCommitCustom,
}: {
  questions: AgentGateQuestion[];
  safeStep: number;
  answers: Record<string, string>;
  qViewportH?: number;
  qTrackY: number;
  qAnimate: boolean;
  questionRefs: MutableRefObject<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>;
  customInputRefs: MutableRefObject<Record<string, HTMLInputElement | null>>;
  isOtherChoice: (question: AgentGateQuestion) => boolean;
  customDraft: Record<string, string>;
  onSelectOption: (questionId: string, opt: string) => void;
  onSelectOther: (questionId: string) => void;
  onUpdateCustom: (questionId: string, text: string) => void;
  onCommitCustom: (questionId: string, raw?: string) => void;
}) => (
  <div
    aria-live="polite"
    className={cn(
      "agent-gate-viewport -m-px h-(--agent-gate-viewport-h) w-full overflow-hidden p-px",
      qAnimate &&
        "transition-[height] duration-[360ms] ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none"
    )}
    data-animate={qAnimate ? "true" : undefined}
    data-slot="agent-gate-questions"
    style={
      // SAFETY: custom properties are valid CSS; CSSProperties omits `--*` keys.
      {
        "--agent-gate-viewport-h":
          qViewportH === undefined ? "auto" : `${qViewportH}px`,
      } as CSSProperties
    }
  >
    <div
      className={cn(
        "agent-gate-track relative flex translate-y-(--agent-gate-track-y) flex-col gap-7",
        qAnimate &&
          "transition-transform duration-[360ms] ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none"
      )}
      data-animate={qAnimate ? "true" : undefined}
      style={
        // SAFETY: custom properties are valid CSS; CSSProperties omits `--*` keys.
        {
          "--agent-gate-track-y": `${-qTrackY}px`,
        } as CSSProperties
      }
    >
      {questions.map((question, qi) => {
        const otherOn = isOtherChoice(question);
        const answer = answers[question.id];
        const draft =
          customDraft[question.id] ??
          (otherOn && answer && !question.options.includes(answer)
            ? answer
            : "");
        return (
          <QuestionSlide
            active={qi === safeStep}
            answers={answers}
            draft={draft}
            inputRef={(el) => {
              customInputRefs.current[question.id] = el;
            }}
            key={question.id}
            onCommitCustom={(raw) => onCommitCustom(question.id, raw)}
            onSelectOption={(opt) => onSelectOption(question.id, opt)}
            onSelectOther={() => onSelectOther(question.id)}
            onUpdateCustom={(text) => onUpdateCustom(question.id, text)}
            otherOn={otherOn}
            qAnimate={qAnimate}
            question={question}
            slideRef={(el) => {
              questionRefs.current[qi] = el;
            }}
          />
        );
      })}
    </div>
  </div>
);

const GateIconSwap = ({
  children,
  className,
  iconKey,
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  iconKey: string;
}) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden
      className={cn(
        "relative inline-flex flex-none items-center justify-center",
        className ?? "size-3.5"
      )}
    >
      <AnimatePresence initial={false} mode="popLayout">
        <motion.span
          animate={{ filter: "blur(0px)", opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          className="absolute inset-0 inline-flex items-center justify-center"
          exit={{ filter: "blur(4px)", opacity: 0, scale: 0.25 }}
          initial={{ filter: "blur(4px)", opacity: 0, scale: 0.25 }}
          key={iconKey}
          transition={
            reduce
              ? { duration: 0 }
              : { bounce: 0, duration: 0.3, type: "spring" }
          }
        >
          {children}
        </motion.span>
      </AnimatePresence>
    </span>
  );
};

const GrantMark = ({
  className,
  duration,
  tone,
}: {
  className?: string;
  duration: AgentGateDuration;
  tone: "permission" | "secret";
}) => {
  const toneClass =
    tone === "permission"
      ? "text-(--agent-gate-permission)"
      : "text-(--agent-gate-secret)";
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "relative inline-flex size-4 flex-none items-center justify-center",
        className
      )}
    >
      <GateIconSwap className="size-4" iconKey={duration}>
        {duration === "always" ? (
          <HugeiconsIcon
            aria-hidden="true"
            className={cn("size-3.5", toneClass)}
            icon={Tick02Icon}
            strokeWidth={2}
          />
        ) : (
          <TodoDashedIcon
            className={
              duration === "session" ? toneClass : "text-muted-foreground"
            }
          />
        )}
      </GateIconSwap>
    </span>
  );
};

const PlanMoreIcon = ({ expanded }: { expanded: boolean }) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden
      className="relative mt-px inline-flex size-4 flex-none items-center justify-center"
    >
      <AnimatePresence initial={false} mode="popLayout">
        <motion.span
          animate={{ filter: "blur(0px)", opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
          className="absolute inset-0 inline-flex items-center justify-center"
          exit={{ filter: "blur(4px)", opacity: 0, scale: 0.25 }}
          initial={{ filter: "blur(4px)", opacity: 0, scale: 0.25 }}
          key={expanded ? "less" : "more"}
          transition={
            reduce
              ? { duration: 0 }
              : { bounce: 0, duration: 0.3, type: "spring" }
          }
        >
          <svg aria-hidden className="size-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <title>{expanded ? "Show less" : "Show more"}</title>
            {expanded ? (
              <rect
                fill="currentColor"
                height="1.5"
                rx="0.75"
                width="14.5"
                x="4.75"
                y="11.25"
              />
            ) : (
              <>
                <circle cx="6" cy="12" fill="currentColor" r="1.25" />
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" fill="currentColor" r="1.25" />
                <circle cx="18" cy="12" fill="currentColor" r="1.25" />
              </>
            )}
          </svg>
        </motion.span>
      </AnimatePresence>
    </span>
  );
};

const PlanSection = ({
  title,
  summary,
  plan,
  planPreview,
  planRest,
  hasPlanMore,
  showPlanRest,
  planExpanded,
  onToggleMore,
}: {
  title: string;
  summary: string;
  plan: AgentGatePlanStep[];
  planPreview: AgentGatePlanStep[];
  planRest: AgentGatePlanStep[];
  hasPlanMore: boolean;
  showPlanRest: boolean;
  planExpanded: boolean;
  onToggleMore: () => void;
}) => (
  <>
    <div
      className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5 pl-0.5"
      data-slot="agent-gate-plan-intro"
    >
      <div className="text-agent-gate-lg leading-agent-gate-tight tracking-agent-gate font-medium text-balance text-card-foreground">
        {title}
      </div>
      <div className="text-agent-gate-sm leading-agent-gate text-pretty whitespace-pre-line text-muted-foreground">
        {summary}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div
      className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 pt-2 pb-2.5 dark:bg-background"
      data-slot="agent-gate-todos"
    >
      <div className="text-agent-gate flex min-h-5.5 w-full items-center gap-2 text-card-foreground">
        <span className="relative size-3.5 flex-none text-card-foreground">
          <HugeiconsIcon
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="absolute inset-0 m-auto size-3.5"
            icon={CheckListIcon}
            strokeWidth={2}
          />
        </span>
        <span className="font-medium">To-dos</span>
        <span className="ml-auto text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
          {plan.length}
        </span>
      </div>
      <ul className="text-agent-gate m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 px-0 pt-2 pb-0">
        {planPreview.map((stepItem) => (
          <PlanTodoItem
            detail={stepItem.detail}
            key={stepItem.id}
            title={stepItem.title}
          />
        ))}
      </ul>
      {hasPlanMore ? (
        <>
          <div
            className={cn(
              "transition-agent-gate-grid ease-agent-gate grid duration-280 motion-reduce:transition-none",
              showPlanRest
                ? "grid-rows-[1fr] opacity-100"
                : "pointer-events-none grid-rows-[0fr] opacity-0"
            )}
          >
            <div className="min-h-0 overflow-hidden">
              <ul className="text-agent-gate m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 px-0 pt-2 pb-0">
                {planRest.map((stepItem) => (
                  <PlanTodoItem
                    detail={stepItem.detail}
                    key={stepItem.id}
                    title={stepItem.title}
                  />
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            aria-expanded={planExpanded}
            className="font-inherit text-agent-gate transition-agent-gate-color relative mt-2 flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2.25 border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-left leading-4.5 text-muted-foreground duration-150 ease-out after:absolute after:top-1/2 after:left-0 after:h-10 after:w-full after:-translate-y-1/2 after:content-[''] hover:text-card-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none active:scale-[0.96] dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80"
            onClick={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              onToggleMore();
            }}
            type="button"
          >
            <PlanMoreIcon expanded={planExpanded} />
            {planExpanded ? "Show less" : `${planRest.length} more`}
          </button>
        </>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  </>
);

const BrandMark = ({
  brand,
  className,
}: {
  brand: AgentGateBrand;
  className?: string;
}) => {
  switch (brand) {
    case "figma": {
      return (
        <svg aria-hidden="true" className={className} viewBox="0 0 38 57">
          <path
            d="M9.5 57A9.5 9.5 0 0 0 19 47.5V38H9.5a9.5 9.5 0 0 0 0 19z"
            fill="var(--color-figma-green)"
          />
          <path
            d="M0 28.5A9.5 9.5 0 0 1 9.5 19H19v19H9.5A9.5 9.5 0 0 1 0 28.5z"
            fill="var(--color-figma-purple)"
          />
          <path
            d="M0 9.5A9.5 9.5 0 0 1 9.5 0H19v19H9.5A9.5 9.5 0 0 1 0 9.5z"
            fill="var(--color-figma-red)"
          />
          <path
            d="M19 0h9.5a9.5 9.5 0 1 1 0 19H19V0z"
            fill="var(--color-figma-orange)"
          />
          <path
            d="M38 28.5a9.5 9.5 0 1 1-19 0 9.5 9.5 0 0 1 19 0z"
            fill="var(--color-figma-blue)"
          />
        </svg>
      );
    }
    case "vercel": {
      return (
        <svg
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={className}
          fill="currentColor"
          viewBox="0 0 76 65"
        >
          <path d="M37.5274 0 75.0548 65H0L37.5274 0Z" />
        </svg>
      );
    }
    case "linear": {
      return (
        <svg
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn("text-linear dark:text-linear-dark", className)}
          fill="currentColor"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        >
          <path d="M18.74 5.26a2.8 2.8 0 0 0-3.96 0L5.26 14.78a2.8 2.8 0 1 0 3.96 3.96l9.52-9.52a2.8 2.8 0 0 0 0-3.96Z" />
        </svg>
      );
    }
    case "mcp": {
      return (
        <svg
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={className}
          fill="none"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        >
          <circle
            cx="7"
            cy="12"
            r="3.15"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.75"
          />
          <circle
            cx="17"
            cy="12"
            r="3.15"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.75"
          />
          <path
            d="M10.15 12h3.7"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeWidth="1.75"
          />
        </svg>
      );
    }
    default: {
      const _exhaustive: never = brand;
      return _exhaustive;
    }
  }
};

const BrandWell = ({
  brand,
  logo,
}: {
  brand?: AgentGateBrand;
  logo?: ReactNode;
}) => (
  <span
    aria-hidden="true"
    className="inline-flex size-8 flex-none items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-muted text-card-foreground dark:bg-background"
  >
    {logo ??
      (brand ? (
        <BrandMark
          brand={brand}
          className={cn(
            "size-4",
            brand === "figma" && "h-3.75 w-2.5",
            brand === "vercel" && "size-3.5"
          )}
        />
      ) : (
        <HugeiconsIcon
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="size-3.5"
          icon={Plug01Icon}
          strokeWidth={2}
        />
      ))}
  </span>
);

const ScopeList = ({
  heading,
  scopes,
  pending,
}: {
  heading: string;
  scopes: string[];
  pending?: boolean;
}) => (
  <div
    className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 pt-2 pb-2.5 dark:bg-background"
    data-slot="agent-gate-scopes"
  >
    <div className="text-agent-gate flex min-h-5.5 w-full items-center gap-2 text-card-foreground">
      <span className="font-medium">{heading}</span>
      <span className="ml-auto text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
        {scopes.length}
      </span>
    </div>
    {scopes.length > 0 ? (
      <ul className="text-agent-gate m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 px-0 pt-2 pb-0">
        {scopes.map((scope) => (
          <li className="flex items-start gap-2.25 leading-4.5" key={scope}>
            <span className="relative mt-px size-4 flex-none text-muted-foreground">
              {pending ? (
                <TodoDashedIcon />
              ) : (
                <HugeiconsIcon
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className="size-3.5"
                  icon={Tick02Icon}
                  strokeWidth={2}
                />
              )}
            </span>
            <span className="text-pretty text-card-foreground">{scope}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    ) : null}
  </div>
);

const PluginSection = ({ plugin }: { plugin: AgentGatePlugin }) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();

  return (
    <AnimatePresence initial={false} mode="wait">
      <motion.div
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        className="flex flex-col gap-3"
        data-slot="agent-gate-plugin"
        exit={reduce ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, y: -6 }}
        initial={reduce ? { opacity: 1 } : { opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
        key={plugin.id}
        transition={
          reduce ? { duration: 0 } : { duration: 0.2, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }
        }
      >
        <div
          className="flex min-w-0 items-start gap-2.5 pl-0.5"
          data-slot="agent-gate-plugin-intro"
        >
          <BrandWell brand={plugin.brand} logo={plugin.logo} />
          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
            <div className="text-agent-gate-lg leading-agent-gate-tight tracking-agent-gate font-medium text-balance text-card-foreground">
              {plugin.name}
            </div>
            <div className="text-agent-gate-sm leading-agent-gate text-pretty text-muted-foreground">
              {plugin.unlock}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <ScopeList heading="Requested" pending scopes={plugin.scopes} />
      </motion.div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
};

}) => (
  <div className="flex flex-col gap-3" data-slot="agent-gate-permission">

      data-slot="agent-gate-permission-intro"
    >

      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5">

          {permission.plugin} {permission.action}
        </div>
        {permission.resource ? (
          <div className="text-agent-gate-sm leading-agent-gate truncate font-mono text-muted-foreground">
            {permission.resource}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div
      className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 pt-2 pb-2.5 dark:bg-background"
      data-slot="agent-gate-permission-call"
    >
      <div className="text-agent-gate flex min-h-5.5 w-full items-center gap-2 text-card-foreground">
        <span className="font-medium">
          {permission.detail ? "This call" : "Access"}
        </span>
        <span className="text-agent-gate-xs ml-auto font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          {durationLabel(duration)}
        </span>
      </div>
      {permission.detail ? (
        <pre className="text-agent-gate-sm leading-agent-gate-relaxed m-0 font-mono wrap-break-word whitespace-pre-wrap text-card-foreground">

        </pre>
      ) : null}
      {permission.scopes.length > 0 ? (
        <ul
          className={cn(
            "text-agent-gate m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 px-0 pb-0",
            permission.detail ? "border-t border-foreground/6 pt-2" : "pt-0"
          )}
        >
          {permission.scopes.map((scope) => (
            <li className="flex items-start gap-2.25 leading-4.5" key={scope}>
              <GrantMark
                className="mt-px"
                duration={duration}
                tone="permission"
              />
              <span className="text-pretty text-card-foreground">{scope}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  </div>
);

const EvalSection = ({
  evaluation,
  notes,
  onNotesChange,
  passing,
  threshold,
}: {
  evaluation: AgentGateEval;
  notes: string;
  onNotesChange: (next: string) => void;
  passing: boolean;
  threshold: number;
}) => {
  const issues = evaluation.issues ?? [];

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3" data-slot="agent-gate-eval">
      <div
        className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5 pl-0.5"
        data-slot="agent-gate-eval-intro"
      >
        <div className="text-agent-gate-lg leading-agent-gate-tight tracking-agent-gate flex items-baseline gap-1.5 font-medium text-card-foreground">
          <span className={cn("tabular-nums", !passing && "text-destructive")}>
            <RollingDigits value={formatGateScore(evaluation.overall)} />
          </span>
          <span className="text-agent-gate-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
            / {formatGateScore(threshold)}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-agent-gate-sm leading-agent-gate text-pretty text-muted-foreground">
          {passing ? "Ready to ship" : "Below the ship threshold"}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div
        className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 pt-2 pb-2.5 dark:bg-background"
        data-slot="agent-gate-eval-scorecard"
      >
        <div className="text-agent-gate flex min-h-5.5 w-full items-center gap-2 text-card-foreground">
          <span className="font-medium">Criteria</span>
          <span className="ml-auto text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
            {evaluation.criteria.length}
          </span>
        </div>
        {evaluation.criteria.length > 0 ? (
          <ul className="text-agent-gate m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 px-0 pb-0">
            {evaluation.criteria.map((criterion) => {
              const under = criterion.score < threshold;
              return (
                <li
                  className="flex items-center gap-2.25 leading-4.5"
                  key={criterion.id}
                >
                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-pretty text-card-foreground">
                    {criterion.label}
                  </span>
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      "flex-none tabular-nums",
                      under ? "text-destructive" : "text-muted-foreground"
                    )}
                  >
                    {formatGateScore(criterion.score)}
                  </span>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        ) : null}
        {issues.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <div className="text-agent-gate flex min-h-5.5 w-full items-center gap-2 border-t border-foreground/6 pt-2 text-card-foreground">
              <span className="font-medium">Issues</span>
              <span className="ml-auto text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                {issues.length}
              </span>
            </div>
            <ul className="text-agent-gate m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 px-0 pb-0">
              {issues.map((issue) => (
                <li
                  className="flex items-start gap-2.25 leading-4.5"
                  key={issue}
                >
                  <span className="relative mt-px size-4 flex-none text-muted-foreground">
                    <HugeiconsIcon
                      aria-hidden="true"
                      className="size-3.5"
                      icon={AlertCircleIcon}
                      strokeWidth={2}
                    />
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-pretty text-card-foreground">
                    {issue}
                  </span>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <div
        className={cn(
          OPTION_CLASS,
          "cursor-text has-focus-visible:ring-2 has-focus-visible:ring-ring/50 has-focus-visible:outline-none dark:has-focus-visible:ring-ring/80"
        )}
        data-selected={notes.trim() ? "true" : undefined}
      >
        <input
          aria-label="Eval notes"
          className="font-inherit leading-inherit relative z-1 m-0 min-w-0 flex-1 border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-inherit outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground"
          onChange={(event) => onNotesChange(event.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (isApproveHotkey(event)) {
              return;
            }
            event.stopPropagation();
          }}
          placeholder="Notes (optional)"
          type="text"
          value={notes}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const COPIED_MS = 1600;

const SecretSection = ({
  duration,
  secrets,
}: {
  duration: AgentGateDuration;
  secrets: AgentGateSecret[];
}) => {
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const copiedTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (copiedTimer.current) {
        clearTimeout(copiedTimer.current);
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const announce = (message: string) => {
    setNotice(message);
  };

  const markCopied = (id: string) => {
    setCopiedId(id);
    if (copiedTimer.current) {
      clearTimeout(copiedTimer.current);
    }
    copiedTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setCopiedId((current) => (current === id ? null : current));
    }, COPIED_MS);
  };

  const copyKey = async (secret: AgentGateSecret) => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(secret.key);
      markCopied(secret.id);
      announce(`Copied ${secret.key}`);
    } catch {
      announce(`Could not copy ${secret.key}`);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3" data-slot="agent-gate-secret">
      <div
        className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5 pl-0.5"
        data-slot="agent-gate-secret-intro"
      >
        <div className="text-agent-gate-lg leading-agent-gate-tight tracking-agent-gate font-medium text-balance text-card-foreground">
          Env and credentials
        </div>
        <div className="text-agent-gate-sm leading-agent-gate text-pretty text-muted-foreground">
          {secretAccessSummary(secrets)}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div
        className="rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 pt-2 pb-2.5 dark:bg-background"
        data-slot="agent-gate-secret-keys"
      >
        <div className="text-agent-gate flex min-h-5.5 w-full items-center gap-2 text-card-foreground">
          <span className="font-medium">Keys</span>
          <span className="text-agent-gate-xs ml-auto font-medium text-muted-foreground">
            {durationLabel(duration)}
          </span>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
            {secrets.length}
          </span>
        </div>
        {secrets.length > 0 ? (
          <ul className="text-agent-gate m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-2 px-0 pt-2 pb-0">
            {secrets.map((secret) => {
              const isRevealed = Boolean(revealed[secret.id]);
              const isCopied = copiedId === secret.id;
              const displayed =
                isRevealed && secret.value ? secret.value : secret.masked;
              return (
                <li
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 leading-4.5"
                  key={secret.id}
                >
                  <GrantMark duration={duration} tone="secret" />
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5">
                    <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5">
                      <span className="truncate font-mono text-pretty text-card-foreground">
                        {secret.key}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-agent-gate-2xs flex-none font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                        {secretAccessLabel(secret.access)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-agent-gate-xs truncate font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                      {displayed}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {secret.value ? (
                    <HeadAction
                      label={
                        isRevealed
                          ? `Hide ${secret.key}`
                          : `Reveal ${secret.key}`
                      }
                      onClick={() => {
                        const next = !isRevealed;
                        setRevealed((prev) => ({ ...prev, [secret.id]: next }));
                        announce(
                          next
                            ? `Showing ${secret.key}`
                            : `Hiding ${secret.key}`
                        );
                      }}
                    >
                      <GateIconSwap iconKey={isRevealed ? "hide" : "show"}>
                        <HugeiconsIcon
                          aria-hidden="true"
                          className="size-3.5 flex-none"
                          icon={isRevealed ? ViewOffIcon : ViewIcon}
                          strokeWidth={2}
                        />
                      </GateIconSwap>
                    </HeadAction>
                  ) : null}
                  <HeadAction
                    label={
                      isCopied ? `Copied ${secret.key}` : `Copy ${secret.key}`
                    }
                    onClick={() => {
                      void copyKey(secret);
                    }}
                  >
                    <GateIconSwap iconKey={isCopied ? "copied" : "copy"}>
                      <HugeiconsIcon
                        aria-hidden="true"
                        className={cn(
                          "size-3.5 flex-none",
                          isCopied && "text-card-foreground"
                        )}
                        icon={isCopied ? Tick02Icon : Copy01Icon}
                        strokeWidth={2}
                      />
                    </GateIconSwap>
                  </HeadAction>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      <output aria-live="polite" className="sr-only">
        {notice}
      </output>
    </div>
  );
};

const HandoffSection = ({
  handoff,
  selected,
  onSelect,
}: {
  handoff: AgentGateHandoff;
  selected: string;
  onSelect: (id: string) => void;
}) => (
  <div className="flex flex-col gap-3" data-slot="agent-gate-handoff">
    <div
      className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5 pl-0.5"
      data-slot="agent-gate-handoff-intro"
    >
      <div className="text-agent-gate-lg leading-agent-gate-tight tracking-agent-gate font-medium text-balance text-card-foreground">
        {handoff.reason}
      </div>
      <div className="text-agent-gate-sm leading-agent-gate text-pretty whitespace-pre-line text-muted-foreground">
        {handoff.excerpt}
      </div>
    </div>
    <fieldset className="m-0 flex flex-col gap-1.25 border-0 p-0">
      <legend className="sr-only">Assign to</legend>
      {handoff.targets.map((target, index) => {
        const isSelected = selected === target.id;
        return (
          <label
            className={cn(OPTION_CLASS, "cursor-pointer")}
            data-selected={isSelected ? "true" : undefined}
            data-slot="agent-gate-handoff-target"
            key={target.id}
          >
            <input
              checked={isSelected}
              className="sr-only"
              name="agent-gate-handoff-target"
              onChange={() => onSelect(target.id)}
              type="radio"
              value={target.id}
            />
            <OptionKey
              letter={String.fromCodePoint(65 + index)}
              selected={isSelected}
            />
            <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{target.label}</span>
              <span className="text-agent-gate-2xs flex-none font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                {handoffKindLabel(target.kind)}
              </span>
            </span>
          </label>
        );
      })}
    </fieldset>
  </div>
);

const ChipPicker = <T extends string>({
  label,
  onChange,
  options,
  value,
}: {
  label: string;
  onChange: (next: T) => void;
  options: readonly { id: T; label: string }[];
  value: T;
}) => {
  const name = useId();

  return (
    <div
      aria-label={label}
      className="inline-flex h-6 flex-none items-center rounded-full bg-foreground/6 p-0.5"
      role="radiogroup"
    >
      {options.map((item) => {
        const selected = value === item.id;
        return (
          <label
            className={cn(
              "transition-agent-gate-chip relative inline-flex h-5 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full px-2 text-(length:--text-agent-gate-sm) leading-none font-medium whitespace-nowrap duration-150 ease-out select-none",
              "after:absolute after:inset-x-0 after:-inset-y-2 after:content-['']",
              "has-focus-visible:ring-2 has-focus-visible:ring-ring/50 has-focus-visible:outline-none dark:has-focus-visible:ring-ring/80",
              selected
                ? "bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)] dark:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.08)]"
                : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-card-foreground",
              "active:scale-[0.96]"
            )}
            data-selected={selected ? "true" : undefined}
            key={item.id}
          >
            <input
              checked={selected}
              className="sr-only"
              name={name}
              onChange={() => onChange(item.id)}
              type="radio"
              value={item.id}
            />
            {item.label}
          </label>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};
