const StepNav = ({
  safeStep,
  total,
  stepLabel,
  onPrev,
  onNext,
  label,
  prevLabel,
  nextLabel,
}: {
  safeStep: number;
  total: number;
  stepLabel: string;
  onPrev: () => void;
  onNext: () => void;
  label?: string;
  prevLabel?: string;
  nextLabel?: string;
}) => (
  <nav
    aria-label={label ?? `Question ${safeStep + 1} of ${total}`}
    className="inline-flex flex-none items-center gap-1 text-muted-foreground"
  >
    <button
      aria-label={prevLabel ?? "Previous question"}
      className="transition-agent-gate-color disabled:opacity-agent-gate-faint relative inline-flex size-4.5 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center border-0 bg-transparent p-0 leading-none text-inherit duration-150 ease-out after:absolute after:top-1/2 after:left-1/2 after:size-10 after:-translate-x-1/2 after:-translate-y-1/2 after:content-[''] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none hover:enabled:text-card-foreground active:enabled:scale-[0.96] disabled:cursor-default dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80"
      disabled={safeStep <= 0}
      onClick={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        onPrev();
      }}
      type="button"
    >
      <HugeiconsIcon
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="size-3.5"
        icon={ArrowUp01Icon}
        strokeWidth={2}
      />
    </button>
    <span className="tracking-agent-gate-label inline-flex flex-none items-center overflow-hidden text-xs leading-none font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
      <RollingDigits value={stepLabel} />
    </span>
    <button
      aria-label={nextLabel ?? "Next question"}
      className="transition-agent-gate-color disabled:opacity-agent-gate-faint relative inline-flex size-4.5 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center border-0 bg-transparent p-0 leading-none text-inherit duration-150 ease-out after:absolute after:top-1/2 after:left-1/2 after:size-10 after:-translate-x-1/2 after:-translate-y-1/2 after:content-[''] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none hover:enabled:text-card-foreground active:enabled:scale-[0.96] disabled:cursor-default dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80"
      disabled={safeStep >= total - 1}
      onClick={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        onNext();
      }}
      type="button"
    >
      <HugeiconsIcon
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="size-3.5"
        icon={ArrowDown01Icon}
        strokeWidth={2}
      />
    </button>
  </nav>
);

const AutoApprove = ({
  autoSecs,
  leaving,
  onCancel,
}: {
  autoSecs: number;
  leaving: boolean;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) => {
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();

  return (
    <output
      aria-label={`Auto approve in ${autoSecs} seconds`}
      className={cn(
        "transition-agent-gate-fade inline-flex min-w-0 flex-none items-center gap-1.25 text-muted-foreground duration-150 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
        leaving && "pointer-events-none -translate-y-3 opacity-0"
      )}
    >
      <span className="after:text-agent-gate-3xs after:blur-agent-gate after:backdrop-blur-agent-gate-md after:transition-agent-gate-glow relative inline-flex flex-none leading-none after:pointer-events-none after:absolute after:bottom-[calc(100%+2px)] after:left-1/2 after:translate-x-[-50%] after:translate-y-px after:rounded-md after:bg-foreground/70 after:px-1.25 after:py-1 after:leading-none after:font-medium after:whitespace-nowrap after:text-background after:opacity-0 after:duration-150 after:ease-out after:content-['Cancel'] focus-within:after:translate-y-0 focus-within:after:opacity-100 focus-within:after:blur-none hover:after:translate-y-0 hover:after:opacity-100 hover:after:blur-none">
        <button
          aria-label="Cancel auto approve"
          className="group/cancel relative inline-flex size-4 flex-none cursor-pointer items-center justify-center border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-(--agent-gate-plan) after:absolute after:top-1/2 after:left-1/2 after:z-1 after:size-10 after:-translate-x-1/2 after:-translate-y-1/2 after:content-[''] focus-visible:outline-none disabled:cursor-default"
          disabled={leaving}
          onClick={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            onCancel();
          }}
          type="button"
        >
          <svg
            aria-hidden
            className="transition-agent-gate-scale ease-agent-gate-out block size-4 flex-none text-inherit duration-300 group-hover/cancel:scale-[0.25] group-hover/cancel:opacity-0 group-hover/cancel:blur-xs group-focus-visible/cancel:scale-[0.25] group-focus-visible/cancel:opacity-0 group-focus-visible/cancel:blur-xs motion-reduce:transition-none"
            height="16"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            width="16"
          >
            <title>Auto approve progress</title>
            <circle
              className="stroke-(--agent-gate-plan-soft)"
              cx="12"
              cy="12"
              fill="none"
              r="9"
              strokeWidth="1.8"
            />
            <circle
              className={cn(
                "agent-gate-progress-stroke stroke-current",
                reduceMotion && "transition-none"
              )}
              cx="12"
              cy="12"
              fill="none"
              pathLength={1}
              r="9"
              strokeDasharray={1}
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeWidth="1.8"
              style={
                // SAFETY: custom properties are valid CSS; CSSProperties omits `--*` keys.
                {
                  "--agent-gate-dash-offset": String(
                    1 - (AUTO_APPROVE_SECS - autoSecs) / AUTO_APPROVE_SECS
                  ),
                } as CSSProperties
              }
              transform="rotate(-90 12 12)"
            />
          </svg>
          <span
            aria-hidden
            className="transition-agent-gate-scale ease-agent-gate-out pointer-events-none absolute inset-px inline-flex scale-[0.25] items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-(--agent-gate-plan-soft) text-(--agent-gate-plan) opacity-0 blur-xs duration-300 group-hover/cancel:scale-100 group-hover/cancel:opacity-100 group-hover/cancel:blur-none group-focus-visible/cancel:scale-100 group-focus-visible/cancel:opacity-100 group-focus-visible/cancel:blur-none motion-reduce:transition-none"
          >
            <HugeiconsIcon
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="size-2"
              icon={Cancel01Icon}
              strokeWidth={2.5}
            />
          </span>
        </button>
      </span>
      <span className="text-xs leading-none whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums">
        Auto Approve in{" "}
        <span className="inline-flex items-center overflow-hidden align-baseline leading-none font-medium tabular-nums">
          <RollingDigits value={String(autoSecs)} />
        </span>
        s
      </span>
    </output>
  );
};

const ActionBar = ({
  leading,
  rejectLabel,
  approveLabel,
  canContinue,
  onReject,
  approveRef,
}: {
  leading: ReactNode;
  rejectLabel: string;
  approveLabel: string;
  canContinue: boolean;
  onReject: () => void;
  approveRef: Ref<HTMLButtonElement>;
}) => {
  const isApple = useIsApplePlatform();

  return (
    <div
      className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pl-0.5"
      data-slot="agent-gate-actions"
    >
      {leading}
      <div className="ml-auto flex justify-end gap-1.5">
        <ActionButton
          onClick={onReject}
          slot="agent-gate-reject"
          variant="ghost"
        >
          {rejectLabel}
        </ActionButton>
        <ActionButton
          buttonRef={approveRef}
          disabled={!canContinue}
          shortcut={
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5"
            >
              <kbd className="text-agent-gate-3xs pointer-events-none inline-flex h-3.5 min-w-3.5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary-foreground/20 px-0.75 font-sans font-medium text-primary-foreground select-none">
                {isApple ? "⌘" : "Ctrl"}
              </kbd>
              <kbd className="text-agent-gate-3xs pointer-events-none inline-flex h-3.5 min-w-3.5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary-foreground/20 px-0.75 font-sans font-medium text-primary-foreground select-none">
                ↵
              </kbd>
            </span>
          }
          shortcutKeys="Meta+Enter Control+Enter"
          slot="agent-gate-approve"
          submit
          variant="primary"
        >
          {approveLabel}
        </ActionButton>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const resolveAgentGateTitle = ({
  title,
  variant,
  plugin,
  permission,
  fallback,
}: {
  title?: string;
  variant: AgentGateVariant;
  plugin?: AgentGatePlugin;
  permission: AgentGatePermission;
  fallback: string;
}) => {
  if (title) {
    return title;
  }
  switch (variant) {
    case "plugin": {
      if (plugin) {
        return `Connect ${plugin.name} to continue?`;
      }
      return fallback;
    }
    case "permission": {
      return `Allow ${permission.plugin} ${permission.action}?`;
    }
    case "questions":
    case "plan":
    case "eval":
    case "secret":
    case "handoff":
    case "schedule": {
      return fallback;
    }
    default: {
      const _exhaustive: never = variant;
      return _exhaustive;
    }
  }
};

const resolveApproveLabel = ({
  approveLabel,
  evalPassing,
  fallback,
  variant,
}: {
  approveLabel?: string;
  evalPassing: boolean;
  fallback: string;
  variant: AgentGateVariant;
}) => {
  if (approveLabel) {
    return approveLabel;
  }
  if (variant === "eval") {
    return evalPassing ? "Ship" : "Iterate";
  }
  return fallback;
};

const resolveGateContent = ({
  evaluation,
  handoff,
  schedule,
  secrets,
}: Pick<AgentGateProps, "evaluation" | "handoff" | "schedule" | "secrets">) => {
  const resolvedEvaluation = evaluation ?? DEFAULT_EVAL;
  const resolvedHandoff = handoff ?? DEFAULT_HANDOFF;
  const resolvedSchedule = schedule ?? DEFAULT_SCHEDULE;

  return {
    cadence: resolvedSchedule.cadence ?? "daily",
    evalThreshold: resolvedEvaluation.threshold ?? DEFAULT_EVAL_THRESHOLD,
    evaluation: resolvedEvaluation,
    handoff: resolvedHandoff,
    handoffTarget:
      resolvedHandoff.defaultTarget ?? resolvedHandoff.targets[0]?.id ?? "",
    schedule: resolvedSchedule,
    secrets: secrets ?? DEFAULT_SECRETS,
  };
};

const resolveCanContinue = ({
  allAnswered,
  handoffTarget,
  variant,
}: {
  allAnswered: boolean;
  handoffTarget: string;
  variant: AgentGateVariant;
}) => {
  switch (variant) {
    case "questions": {
      return allAnswered;
    }
    case "handoff": {
      return Boolean(handoffTarget);
    }
    case "plan":
    case "plugin":
    case "permission":
    case "eval":
    case "secret":
    case "schedule": {
      return true;
    }
    default: {
      const _exhaustive: never = variant;
      return _exhaustive;
    }
  }
};

const buildApprovePayload = ({
  variant,
  questions,
  answers,
  nextAnswers,
  plugin,
  permission,
  duration,
  evalNotes,
  evalPassing,
  secrets,
  handoff,
  handoffTarget,
  cadence,
  schedule,
}: {
  variant: AgentGateVariant;
  questions: AgentGateQuestion[];
  answers: Record<string, string>;
  nextAnswers?: Record<string, string>;
  plugin?: AgentGatePlugin;
  permission: AgentGatePermission;
  duration: AgentGateDuration;
  evalNotes: string;
  evalPassing: boolean;
  secrets: AgentGateSecret[];
  handoff: AgentGateHandoff;
  handoffTarget: string;
  cadence: AgentGateCadence;
  schedule: AgentGateSchedule;
}): AgentGatePayload | false | undefined => {
  switch (variant) {
    case "questions": {
      const next = nextAnswers ?? answers;
      const ok = questions.every((question) =>
        Boolean(next[question.id]?.trim())
      );
      if (!ok) {
        return false;
      }
      return { answers: next };
    }
    case "plan": {
      return undefined;
    }
    case "plugin": {
      if (!plugin) {
        return false;
      }
      return { plugin: plugin.id, scopes: plugin.scopes };
    }
    case "permission": {
      return {
        duration,
        plugin: permission.plugin,
        scopes: permission.scopes,
      };
    }
    case "eval": {
      const notes = evalNotes.trim();
      const payload: AgentGatePayload = {
        decision: evalPassing ? "accept" : "iterate",
      };
      if (notes) {
        payload.notes = notes;
      }
      return payload;
    }
    case "secret": {
      return {
        duration,
        keys: secrets.map((secret) => secret.key),
      };
    }
    case "handoff": {
      if (!handoffTarget) {
        return false;
      }
      return { reason: handoff.reason, target: handoffTarget };
    }
    case "schedule": {
      const payload: AgentGatePayload = {
        cadence,
        startAt: schedule.startAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      if (schedule.until) {
        payload.until = schedule.until;
      }
      return payload;
    }
    default: {
      const _exhaustive: never = variant;
      return _exhaustive;
    }
  }
};

const AgentGateLeading = ({
  variant,
  questionsLength,
  pluginsLength,
  safeStep,
  stepLabel,
  duration,
  onDurationChange,
  autoSecs,
  autoUI,
  onCancelAuto,
  onGoToStep,
  cadence,
  schedule,
}: {
  variant: AgentGateVariant;
  questionsLength: number;
  pluginsLength: number;
  safeStep: number;
  stepLabel: string;
  duration: AgentGateDuration;
  onDurationChange: (next: AgentGateDuration) => void;
  autoSecs: number;
  autoUI: "active" | "leaving" | "gone";
  onCancelAuto: () => void;
  onGoToStep: (next: number) => void;
  cadence: AgentGateCadence;
  schedule: AgentGateSchedule;
}) => {
  const spacer = <span aria-hidden className="w-0 flex-none" />;

  switch (variant) {
    case "questions": {
      return (
        <StepNav
          onNext={() => onGoToStep(safeStep + 1)}
          onPrev={() => onGoToStep(safeStep - 1)}
          safeStep={safeStep}
          stepLabel={stepLabel}
          total={questionsLength}
        />
      );
    }
    case "plugin": {
      if (pluginsLength > 1) {
        return (
          <StepNav
            label={`Plugin ${safeStep + 1} of ${pluginsLength}`}
            nextLabel="Next plugin"
            onNext={() => onGoToStep(safeStep + 1)}
            onPrev={() => onGoToStep(safeStep - 1)}
            prevLabel="Previous plugin"
            safeStep={safeStep}
            stepLabel={stepLabel}
            total={pluginsLength}
          />
        );
      }
      return spacer;
    }
    case "permission":
    case "secret": {
      return <DurationPicker onChange={onDurationChange} value={duration} />;
    }
    case "plan": {
      if (autoUI !== "gone") {
        return (
          <AutoApprove
            autoSecs={autoSecs}
            leaving={autoUI === "leaving"}
            onCancel={onCancelAuto}
          />
        );
      }
      return spacer;
    }
    case "schedule": {
      return (
        <span className="tracking-agent-gate-label inline-flex min-w-0 items-center truncate text-xs leading-none font-medium text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
          {scheduleLeadingCopy(cadence, schedule)}
        </span>
      );
    }
    case "eval":
    case "handoff": {
      return spacer;
    }
    default: {
      const _exhaustive: never = variant;
      return _exhaustive;
    }
  }
};

const useQuestionLayout = (
  variant: AgentGateVariant,
  safeStep: number,
  reduceMotion: boolean | null
) => {
  const questionRefs = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);
  const qMeasured = useRef(false);
  const [qViewportH, setQViewportH] = useState<number | undefined>();
  const [qTrackY, setQTrackY] = useState(0);
  const [qAnimate, setQAnimate] = useState(false);
  const isQuestions = variant === "questions";

  if (!isQuestions && qViewportH !== undefined) {
    setQViewportH(undefined);
    setQTrackY(0);
    setQAnimate(false);
  }

  const syncQuestionSlide = useCallback(
    (animate: boolean) => {
      const item = questionRefs.current[safeStep];
      if (!item) {
        return;
      }
      setQViewportH(item.offsetHeight + 2);
      setQTrackY(item.offsetTop);
      setQAnimate(animate && !reduceMotion);
    },
    [safeStep, reduceMotion]
  );

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!isQuestions) {
      qMeasured.current = false;
      return;
    }
    const animate = qMeasured.current;
    qMeasured.current = true;
    syncQuestionSlide(animate);
  }, [isQuestions, syncQuestionSlide]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isQuestions) {
      return;
    }
    const id = requestAnimationFrame(() =>
      syncQuestionSlide(qMeasured.current)
    );
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(id);
  }, [isQuestions, syncQuestionSlide]);

  return { qAnimate, qTrackY, qViewportH, questionRefs };
};

const usePlanAutoApprove = (
  variant: AgentGateVariant,
  onApprove?: (payload?: AgentGatePayload) => void
) => {
  const [autoSecs, setAutoSecs] = useState(AUTO_APPROVE_SECS);
  const [autoUI, setAutoUI] = useState<"active" | "leaving" | "gone">("active");
  const autoFadeTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const autoFired = useRef(false);

  const cancelAutoApprove = () => {
    if (autoUI !== "active") {
      return;
    }
    autoFired.current = true;
    setAutoUI("leaving");
    if (autoFadeTimer.current) {
      clearTimeout(autoFadeTimer.current);
    }
    autoFadeTimer.current = setTimeout(() => setAutoUI("gone"), 280);
  };

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (autoFadeTimer.current) {
        clearTimeout(autoFadeTimer.current);
      }
    },
    []
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (variant !== "plan" || autoUI !== "active") {
      return;
    }
    const id = window.setInterval(() => {
      setAutoSecs((secs) => Math.max(0, secs - 1));
    }, 1000);
    return () => window.clearInterval(id);
  }, [variant, autoUI]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (variant !== "plan" || autoUI !== "active") {
      return;
    }
    if (autoSecs > 0 || autoFired.current) {
      return;
    }
    autoFired.current = true;
    onApprove?.();
  }, [autoSecs, variant, autoUI, onApprove]);

  return { autoSecs, autoUI, cancelAutoApprove };
};

const AgentGatePlanActions = ({
  expanded,
  hasMore,
  onDownload,
  onToggle,
}: {
  expanded: boolean;
  hasMore: boolean;
  onDownload?: () => void;
  onToggle: () => void;
}) => (
  <div className="ml-auto inline-flex flex-none items-center gap-0.5">
    <HeadAction
      label="Download plan"
      onClick={() => {
        onDownload?.();
      }}
    >
      <HugeiconsIcon
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="size-3.5 flex-none"
        icon={Download01Icon}
        strokeWidth={2}
      />
    </HeadAction>
    {hasMore ? (
      <HeadAction
        label={expanded ? "Collapse plan" : "Expand plan"}
        onClick={onToggle}
      >
        <GateIconSwap iconKey={expanded ? "collapse" : "expand"}>
          <HugeiconsIcon
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="size-3.5 flex-none"
            icon={expanded ? MinimizeScreenIcon : MaximizeScreenIcon}
            strokeWidth={2}
          />
        </GateIconSwap>
      </HeadAction>
    ) : null}
  </div>
);

const AgentGateMain = ({
  variant,
  questions,
  answers,
  customDraft,
  customInputRefs,
  isOtherChoice,
  onCommitCustom,
  onSelectOption,
  onSelectOther,
  onUpdateCustom,
  qAnimate,
  qTrackY,
  questionRefs,
  qViewportH,
  safeStep,
  hasPlanMore,
  onToggleMore,
  plan,
  planExpanded,
  planPreview,
  planRest,
  showPlanRest,
  planSummary,
  planTitle,
  currentPlugin,
  duration,
  permission,
  evaluation,
  evalNotes,
  onEvalNotesChange,
  evalPassing,
  evalThreshold,
  secrets,
  handoff,
  handoffTarget,
  onHandoffTargetChange,
  cadence,
  onCadenceChange,
  schedule,
}: {
  variant: AgentGateVariant;
  questions: AgentGateQuestion[];
  answers: Record<string, string>;
  customDraft: Record<string, string>;
  customInputRefs: MutableRefObject<Record<string, HTMLInputElement | null>>;
  isOtherChoice: (question: AgentGateQuestion) => boolean;
  onCommitCustom: (questionId: string, raw?: string) => void;
  onSelectOption: (questionId: string, opt: string) => void;
  onSelectOther: (questionId: string) => void;
  onUpdateCustom: (questionId: string, text: string) => void;
  qAnimate: boolean;
  qTrackY: number;
  questionRefs: MutableRefObject<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>;
  qViewportH?: number;
  safeStep: number;
  hasPlanMore: boolean;
  onToggleMore: () => void;
  plan: AgentGatePlanStep[];
  planExpanded: boolean;
  planPreview: AgentGatePlanStep[];
  planRest: AgentGatePlanStep[];
  showPlanRest: boolean;
  planSummary?: string;
  planTitle?: string;
  currentPlugin?: AgentGatePlugin;
  duration: AgentGateDuration;
  permission: AgentGatePermission;
  evaluation: AgentGateEval;
  evalNotes: string;
  onEvalNotesChange: (next: string) => void;
  evalPassing: boolean;
  evalThreshold: number;
  secrets: AgentGateSecret[];
  handoff: AgentGateHandoff;
  handoffTarget: string;
  onHandoffTargetChange: (id: string) => void;
  cadence: AgentGateCadence;
  onCadenceChange: (next: AgentGateCadence) => void;
  schedule: AgentGateSchedule;
}) => {
  switch (variant) {
    case "questions": {
      if (questions.length === 0) {
        return null;
      }
      return (
        <QuestionsViewport
          answers={answers}
          customDraft={customDraft}
          customInputRefs={customInputRefs}
          isOtherChoice={isOtherChoice}
          onCommitCustom={onCommitCustom}
          onSelectOption={onSelectOption}
          onSelectOther={onSelectOther}
          onUpdateCustom={onUpdateCustom}
          qAnimate={qAnimate}
          qTrackY={qTrackY}
          questionRefs={questionRefs}
          questions={questions}
          qViewportH={qViewportH}
          safeStep={safeStep}
        />
      );
    }
    case "plan": {
      return (
        <PlanSection
          hasPlanMore={hasPlanMore}
          onToggleMore={onToggleMore}
          plan={plan}
          planExpanded={planExpanded}
          planPreview={planPreview}
          planRest={planRest}
          showPlanRest={showPlanRest}
          summary={planSummary ?? DEFAULT_PLAN_SUMMARY}
          title={planTitle ?? DEFAULT_PLAN_TITLE}
        />
      );
    }
    case "plugin": {
      if (!currentPlugin) {
        return null;
      }
      return <PluginSection plugin={currentPlugin} />;
    }
    case "permission": {
      return <PermissionSection duration={duration} permission={permission} />;
    }
    case "eval": {
      return (
        <EvalSection
          evaluation={evaluation}
          notes={evalNotes}
          onNotesChange={onEvalNotesChange}
          passing={evalPassing}
          threshold={evalThreshold}
        />
      );
    }
    case "secret": {
      return <SecretSection duration={duration} secrets={secrets} />;
    }
    case "handoff": {
      return (
        <HandoffSection
          handoff={handoff}
          onSelect={onHandoffTargetChange}
          selected={handoffTarget}
        />
      );
    }
    case "schedule": {
      return (
        <ScheduleSection
          cadence={cadence}
          onCadenceChange={onCadenceChange}
          schedule={schedule}
        />
      );
    }
    default: {
      const _exhaustive: never = variant;
      return _exhaustive;
    }
  }
};

/**
 * Human-in-the-loop agent gate: paged questions, a plan with auto-approve, a
 * plugin connect, a permission gate, an eval scorecard, secret access, a
 * human handoff, or a scheduled run. Surfaces, type, and actions use shadcn
 * theme tokens. Override `--agent-gate-*` accent tokens to retheme variant
 * colors.
 */
export const AgentGate = ({
  variant = "questions",
  questions = DEFAULT_QUESTIONS,
  plan = DEFAULT_PLAN,
  planTitle,
  planSummary,
  planPreviewCount = DEFAULT_PLAN_PREVIEW,
  plugins = DEFAULT_PLUGINS,
  permission = DEFAULT_PERMISSION,
  permissionDuration,
  defaultPermissionDuration = "once",
  onPermissionDurationChange,
  evaluation: evaluationProp,
  secrets: secretsProp,
  handoff: handoffProp,
  schedule: scheduleProp,
  title,
  approveLabel,
  rejectLabel,
  onApprove,
  onReject,
  onDownload,
  className,
}: AgentGateProps) => {
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const {
    cadence: initialCadence,
    evaluation,
    evalThreshold,
    handoff,
    handoffTarget: initialHandoffTarget,
    schedule,
    secrets,
  } = resolveGateContent({
    evaluation: evaluationProp,
    handoff: handoffProp,
    schedule: scheduleProp,
    secrets: secretsProp,
  });
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [uncontrolledDuration, setUncontrolledDuration] = useState(
    defaultPermissionDuration
  );
  const [evalNotes, setEvalNotes] = useState("");
  const [handoffTarget, setHandoffTarget] = useState(initialHandoffTarget);
  const [uncontrolledCadence, setUncontrolledCadence] =
    useState<AgentGateCadence>(initialCadence);
  const [otherSelected, setOtherSelected] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>(
    {}
  );
  const [customDraft, setCustomDraft] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [planExpanded, setPlanExpanded] = useState(false);
  const advanceTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);
  const approveRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const pointerInsideRef = useRef(false);
  const customInputRefs = useRef<Record<string, HTMLInputElement | null>>({});

  const pageCount = variant === "plugin" ? plugins.length : questions.length;
  const safeStep = Math.min(step, Math.max(pageCount - 1, 0));
  const { questionRefs, qViewportH, qTrackY, qAnimate } = useQuestionLayout(
    variant,
    safeStep,
    reduceMotion
  );
  const { autoSecs, autoUI, cancelAutoApprove } = usePlanAutoApprove(
    variant,
    onApprove
  );

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      if (advanceTimer.current) {
        clearTimeout(advanceTimer.current);
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const currentPlugin = plugins[safeStep];
  const duration = permissionDuration ?? uncontrolledDuration;
  const evalPassing = evaluation.overall >= evalThreshold;
  const cadence = uncontrolledCadence;
  const allAnswered =
    questions.length > 0 &&
    questions.every((question) => Boolean(answers[question.id]?.trim()));
  const stepLabel = `${safeStep + 1} / ${pageCount}`;
  const meta = variantMeta(variant);

  const isOtherChoice = useCallback(
    (question: AgentGateQuestion) => {
      if (otherSelected[question.id]) {
        return true;
      }
      const answer = answers[question.id];
      return Boolean(answer) && !question.options.includes(answer);
    },
    [answers, otherSelected]
  );

  const previewCount = Math.max(0, planPreviewCount);
  const planPreview = plan.slice(0, previewCount);
  const planRest = plan.slice(previewCount);
  const hasPlanMore = planRest.length > 0;
  const showPlanRest = planExpanded || !hasPlanMore;
  const resolvedTitle = resolveAgentGateTitle({
    fallback: meta.title,
    permission,
    plugin: currentPlugin,
    title,
    variant,
  });
  const resolvedApprove = resolveApproveLabel({
    approveLabel,
    evalPassing,
    fallback: meta.approve,
    variant,
  });
  const resolvedReject = rejectLabel ?? meta.reject;
  const canContinue = resolveCanContinue({
    allAnswered,
    handoffTarget,
    variant,
  });

  const setDuration = (next: AgentGateDuration) => {
    if (permissionDuration === undefined) {
      setUncontrolledDuration(next);
    }
    onPermissionDurationChange?.(next);
  };

  const handleApprove = (nextAnswers?: Record<string, string>) => {
    const payload = buildApprovePayload({
      answers,
      cadence,
      duration,
      evalNotes,
      evalPassing,
      handoff,
      handoffTarget,
      nextAnswers,
      permission,
      plugin: currentPlugin,
      questions,
      schedule,
      secrets,
      variant,
    });
    if (payload === false) {
      return;
    }
    onApprove?.(payload);
  };

  const selectOption = (questionId: string, opt: string) => {
    setOtherSelected((prev) => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: false }));
    setAnswers((prev) => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: opt }));
    if (safeStep < questions.length - 1) {
      if (advanceTimer.current) {
        clearTimeout(advanceTimer.current);
      }
      advanceTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setStep((current) => Math.min(current + 1, questions.length - 1));
      }, ADVANCE_MS);
    }
  };

  const selectOther = (questionId: string) => {
    if (advanceTimer.current) {
      clearTimeout(advanceTimer.current);
    }
    setOtherSelected((prev) => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: true }));
    const draft = customDraft[questionId]?.trim() ?? "";
    setAnswers((prev) => writeAnswer(prev, questionId, draft));
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      customInputRefs.current[questionId]?.focus();
    });
  };

  const updateCustom = (questionId: string, text: string) => {
    setCustomDraft((prev) => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: text }));
    setOtherSelected((prev) => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: true }));
    setAnswers((prev) => writeAnswer(prev, questionId, text.trim()));
  };

  const commitCustom = (questionId: string, raw?: string) => {
    const text = (
      raw ??
      customDraft[questionId] ??
      answers[questionId] ??
      ""
    ).trim();
    if (!text) {
      return;
    }
    setCustomDraft((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [questionId]: raw ?? prev[questionId] ?? text,
    }));
    setOtherSelected((prev) => ({ ...prev, [questionId]: true }));
    const nextAnswers = { ...answers, [questionId]: text };
    setAnswers(nextAnswers);
    if (safeStep < questions.length - 1) {
      if (advanceTimer.current) {
        clearTimeout(advanceTimer.current);
      }
      setStep((current) => Math.min(current + 1, questions.length - 1));
      return;
    }
    handleApprove(nextAnswers);
  };

  const goToStep = (next: number) => {
    if (advanceTimer.current) {
      clearTimeout(advanceTimer.current);
    }
    setStep(Math.min(Math.max(next, 0), Math.max(pageCount - 1, 0)));
  };

  const onSubmit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    handleApprove();
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.repeat || !isApproveHotkey(event)) {
        return;
      }

      const form = formRef.current;
      const submitter = approveRef.current;
      if (!(form && submitter) || submitter.disabled) {
        return;
      }

      const focusInside = form.contains(document.activeElement);
      const focusInOtherCard = Boolean(
        !focusInside &&
        document.activeElement?.closest("[data-slot=agent-gate]")
      );
      if (focusInOtherCard) {
        return;
      }
      if (!(focusInside || pointerInsideRef.current)) {
        return;
      }

      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      form.requestSubmit(submitter);
    };

    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown, true);
  }, []);

  const leading = (
    <AgentGateLeading
      autoSecs={autoSecs}
      autoUI={autoUI}
      cadence={cadence}
      duration={duration}
      onCancelAuto={cancelAutoApprove}
      onDurationChange={setDuration}
      onGoToStep={goToStep}
      pluginsLength={plugins.length}
      questionsLength={questions.length}
      safeStep={safeStep}
      schedule={schedule}
      stepLabel={stepLabel}
      variant={variant}
    />
  );

  return (
    <form
      className={cn(
        THEME_VARS,
        "flex w-full flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-card p-3 text-card-foreground shadow-(--agent-gate-shadow) transition-shadow duration-150 ease-out hover:shadow-(--agent-gate-shadow-hover)",
        className
      )}
      data-slot="agent-gate"
      data-variant={variant}
      onPointerEnter={() => {
        pointerInsideRef.current = true;
      }}
      onPointerLeave={() => {
        pointerInsideRef.current = false;
      }}
      onSubmit={onSubmit}
      ref={formRef}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          ENTER_CLASS,
          "flex h-6 items-center gap-2 overflow-visible"
        )}
        data-slot="agent-gate-header"
      >
        <span
          className={cn(
            "inline-flex size-6 flex-none items-center justify-center rounded-md",
            meta.iconClass
          )}
          data-slot="agent-gate-icon"
          data-variant={variant}
        >
          <HugeiconsIcon
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="size-3.5"
            disableSecondaryOpacity
            icon={meta.icon}
            primaryColor={meta.iconPrimary}
            secondaryColor={meta.iconSecondary}
            strokeWidth={2}
          />
        </span>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          <div className="text-agent-gate-md tracking-agent-gate leading-tight font-medium text-balance">
            {resolvedTitle}
          </div>
        </div>
        {variant === "plan" ? (
          <AgentGatePlanActions
            expanded={planExpanded}
            hasMore={hasPlanMore}
            onDownload={onDownload}
            onToggle={() => {
              setPlanExpanded((open) => !open);
            }}
          />
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className={cn(ENTER_CLASS, "flex flex-col gap-3 delay-100")}>
        <AgentGateMain
          answers={answers}
          currentPlugin={currentPlugin}
          customDraft={customDraft}
          duration={duration}
          customInputRefs={customInputRefs}
          evaluation={evaluation}
          evalNotes={evalNotes}
          evalPassing={evalPassing}
          evalThreshold={evalThreshold}
          handoff={handoff}
          handoffTarget={handoffTarget}
          hasPlanMore={hasPlanMore}
          isOtherChoice={isOtherChoice}
          onCadenceChange={setUncontrolledCadence}
          onCommitCustom={commitCustom}
          onEvalNotesChange={setEvalNotes}
          onHandoffTargetChange={setHandoffTarget}
          onSelectOption={selectOption}
          onSelectOther={selectOther}
          onToggleMore={() => setPlanExpanded((open) => !open)}
          onUpdateCustom={updateCustom}
          permission={permission}
          plan={plan}
          planExpanded={planExpanded}
          planPreview={planPreview}
          planRest={planRest}
          planSummary={planSummary}
          planTitle={planTitle}
          qAnimate={qAnimate}
          qTrackY={qTrackY}
          questionRefs={questionRefs}
          questions={questions}
          qViewportH={qViewportH}
          cadence={cadence}
          safeStep={safeStep}
          schedule={schedule}
          secrets={secrets}
          showPlanRest={showPlanRest}
          variant={variant}
        />
      </div>

      <div className={cn(ENTER_CLASS, "delay-200")}>
        <ActionBar
          approveLabel={resolvedApprove}
          approveRef={approveRef}
          canContinue={canContinue}
          leading={leading}
          onReject={() => {
            onReject?.();
          }}
          rejectLabel={resolvedReject}
        />
      </div>
    </form>
  );
};
